zh: AIE就业与端到端交付全景
outcome_zh: 把一个业务需求拆成产品、数据、模型、系统和验收工作。
outcome_en: Translate a business need into product, data, model, system and acceptance work.

nodes.read_zh: 全文；用本仓库岗位总述与中国/北美JD分组校正岗位边界。
nodes.read_en: Full essay; check role boundaries against this repository’s role overview and China/North America JD cohorts.
topics_zh: 应用/系统AIE：AI Engineer、LLM工程师、Agent工程师、Applied AI与FDE
相邻岗位：SDE、MLE、SRE、算法研究、模型训练与GPU平台
招聘存量、新增职位、入职人数、招聘指数、技能提及率的区别
中国与北美的岗位名称、行业、年资和交付模式
岗位JD→能力→学习单元→作品证据→面试问题的映射
topics_en: Application/system roles: AI Engineer, LLM/agent engineer, Applied AI and FDE
Adjacent SDE, MLE, SRE, research, training and GPU-platform roles
Active stock, new postings, hires, indices and skill mentions
China/North America titles, sectors, seniority and delivery models
JD→capability→learning unit→evidence→interview mapping
nodes.build_zh: 选3份目标JD，写出共同能力、差异和可展示的证据。
nodes.build_en: Map three target descriptions to shared skills, differences and demonstrable evidence.
checks_zh: 说明AI Engineer与MLE、算法研究员、SDE在日常产出、评价方式和所需能力上的区别；FDE和Applied AI岗位又处在什么位置？
某招聘网站称“AI Agent”岗位一年增长300%，引用这个数字前你要核实哪些口径（存量还是新增、关键词匹配、去重、样本来源）？
选一份目标JD，挑出3条硬性要求，把每条映射到本路线的单元、你能拿出的证据和一道可能的面试题。
checks_en: How do AI Engineers differ from MLEs, research scientists and SDEs in daily output, how their work is judged and the skills required? Where do FDE and Applied AI roles fit?
A job site claims “AI agent” postings grew 300% in a year. What would you check before quoting it: active stock versus new postings, keyword matching, deduplication and sample source?
Take one target JD, pick three hard requirements and map each to a unit in this roadmap, the evidence you can show and a likely interview question.

nodes.en: From a business problem to an AI system
nodes.read_zh: 项目设计、模型选择、评测和产品化主题。
nodes.read_en: Project design, model choice, evaluation and productization.
topics_zh: 用户、任务、输入输出、场景约束和业务错误成本
规则/传统ML/模型API/RAG/Agent的选型
数据流、控制流、权限流、反馈流
质量、延迟、成本、可靠性与用户体验
发现需求→试点→基线→实现→评测→部署→运营
topics_en: User, task, I/O, constraints and error costs
Rules, classical ML, model APIs, RAG and agents
Data, control, authorization and feedback flows
Quality, latency, cost, reliability and UX
Discovery→pilot→baseline→implementation→evaluation→deployment→operation
nodes.build_zh: 用任务卡画一张端到端架构图并定义验收条件。
nodes.build_en: Produce a task card, an end-to-end diagram and acceptance criteria.
checks_zh: 面对“客服工单自动分类并起草回复”的需求，你会先问哪些问题来确定任务、输入输出、错误代价和验收标准？
什么情况下规则或传统ML比LLM更合适？举一个引入LLM反而变差的例子并说明原因。
为一个内部文档问答系统画出数据流、控制流和权限流，并列出从试点到上线每个阶段的退出条件。
checks_en: For a “classify support tickets and draft replies” request, which questions do you ask first to pin down the task, inputs and outputs, error costs and acceptance criteria?
When are rules or classical ML a better fit than an LLM? Give an example where adding an LLM made things worse and explain why.
Sketch the data, control and authorization flows for an internal document Q&A system, and list exit criteria for each stage from pilot to launch.

outcome_zh: 独立编写、测试、调试和维护可交付的Python服务代码。
outcome_en: Independently write, test, debug and maintain deliverable Python code.

nodes.read_zh: Tutorial：数据结构、函数、模块、类、异常、迭代器与生成器。
nodes.read_en: Tutorial: collections, functions, modules, classes, exceptions, iterators and generators.
topics_zh: 变量、对象、可变性、引用与复制；list/dict/set/tuple
函数参数、作用域、闭包、装饰器与上下文管理器
类、dataclass、协议与组合；抽象接口
异常层次、资源释放、日志与错误传播
迭代器、生成器、文件流与内存占用
topics_en: Objects, mutability, references, copying and collections
Parameters, scope, closures, decorators and context managers
Classes, dataclasses, protocols, composition and interfaces
Exceptions, cleanup, logging and error propagation
Iterators, generators, file streams and memory
nodes.build_zh: 实现流式文档读取与清洗模块，解释其内存和异常边界。
nodes.build_en: Implement streaming document cleaning and explain memory/error boundaries.
checks_zh: 解释Python中可变默认参数、浅拷贝和深拷贝的行为差异，并写出一个因共享引用导致bug的例子。
一个处理大文件的脚本内存持续上涨，你会如何用生成器、流式读取和上下文管理器改写，并验证内存占用？
用dataclass或Protocol设计一个可替换的LLM客户端接口，说明为什么用组合而不是继承。
checks_en: Explain how mutable default arguments, shallow copies and deep copies behave in Python, and write an example where a shared reference causes a bug.
A script processing a large file keeps growing in memory. How would you rewrite it with generators, streamed reads and context managers, and verify the memory profile?
Design a swappable LLM client interface with a dataclass or Protocol, and explain why you chose composition over inheritance.

nodes.read_zh: 类型提示、Request Body、Response Model、Settings与依赖注入。
nodes.read_en: Typing, request/response models, settings and dependency injection.
topics_zh: 类型提示、泛型、Union、Optional与Protocol
Pydantic验证、严格模式、未知字段和业务不变量
JSON Schema、序列化、版本兼容与错误响应
环境配置、配置校验、secret引用和依赖注入
类型检查、运行时校验和业务验证的职责
topics_en: Typing, generics, unions, optionals and protocols
Strict Pydantic validation, extra fields and invariants
JSON Schema, serialization, compatibility and error responses
Configuration validation, secret references and dependency injection
Static types, runtime checks and business rules
nodes.build_zh: 定义任务/工具/结果契约，覆盖合法类型却业务非法的输入。
nodes.build_en: Define task/tool/result contracts including type-valid but business-invalid cases.
checks_zh: 静态类型检查、Pydantic运行时校验和业务规则校验各自能拦住什么错误？分别举一个它拦不住的例子。
模型返回的JSON多了一个字段、某字段从int变成了str，你的Schema应如何配置（strict、extra），调用方应看到什么错误？
设计一个服务的配置加载方案：按环境区分、必填校验、引用密钥而非写明文，以及测试时如何注入替身。
checks_en: What errors do static type checking, Pydantic runtime validation and business-rule validation each catch? Give an example each one misses.
A model’s JSON output gains an extra field and one field changes from int to str. How should your schema be configured (strict, extra), and what error should the caller see?
Design configuration loading for a service: per-environment settings, required-field validation, secret references instead of plaintext, and test-time injection of fakes.

nodes.read_zh: Coroutines and Tasks全文：Task、TaskGroup、timeout、取消与shield；再读asyncio queues与同步原语。
nodes.read_en: Coroutines and Tasks: Task, TaskGroup, timeouts, cancellation and shield; then asyncio queues and synchronization primitives.
topics_zh: event loop、协程、task、await与阻塞I/O
线程/进程/协程的选择；GIL与CPU密集任务
并发上限、信号量、连接池、队列与背压
deadline、超时、取消传播、任务清理
竞态、共享状态、锁与异步错误聚合
topics_en: Event loops, coroutines, tasks, await and blocking I/O
Threads/processes/coroutines, GIL and CPU work
Concurrency limits, pools, queues and backpressure
Deadlines, timeout, cancellation and cleanup
Races, shared state, locks and error aggregation
nodes.build_zh: 给慢模型客户端加并发和排队上限，复现取消后资源泄漏。
nodes.build_en: Bound a slow model client and diagnose leaked capacity after cancellation.
checks_zh: 解释事件循环、协程和Task的关系；为什么在async函数里调用同步HTTP库会拖慢整个服务？
并发调用100次模型API时出现大量429和超时，你如何用信号量、队列和总截止时间重写调用逻辑？
用户中途取消请求后，下游的模型调用和数据库写入应如何取消或清理？说明asyncio中取消如何传播、finally里该做什么。
checks_en: Explain how the event loop, coroutines and tasks relate. Why does calling a synchronous HTTP library inside an async function slow the whole service?
Firing 100 concurrent model API calls produces many 429s and timeouts. How would you rework the calls with a semaphore, a queue and an overall deadline?
When a user cancels mid-request, how should downstream model calls and database writes be cancelled or cleaned up? Describe how cancellation propagates in asyncio and what belongs in finally.

nodes.zh: 算法与数据结构的工程用法
nodes.read_zh: 算法分析、排序与查找、哈希、树与图章节；再按题型做限时练习。
nodes.read_en: Analysis, sorting/searching, hashing, trees and graphs chapters; then timed practice by problem type.
topics_zh: 时间/空间复杂度、排序、二分和哈希
堆、优先队列、LRU、去重与流式top-k
树、图、BFS/DFS、拓扑排序与环检测
字符串处理、Unicode、正则和边界测试
工具结果合并、依赖调度与有限缓存
topics_en: Time/space complexity, sorting, binary search and hashing
Heaps, queues, LRU, deduplication and streaming top-k
Trees/graphs, traversal, topological order and cycles
Strings, Unicode, regex and boundary tests
Result merging, dependency scheduling and bounded caches
nodes.build_zh: 实现一个带去重和环检测的任务依赖调度器。
nodes.build_en: Build a deduplicating dependency scheduler with cycle detection.
checks_zh: 实现一个容量有限的LRU缓存，给出各操作的时间复杂度，并说明用它缓存LLM结果时还要考虑什么。
对多路检索结果去重、合并并取top-k，数据量很大时你会用什么数据结构，复杂度是多少？
给定一组带依赖的任务（如Agent子任务），实现拓扑排序并检测环；出现环时应如何报告给用户？
checks_en: Implement a bounded LRU cache, give the complexity of each operation, and say what else matters when using it to cache LLM results.
To deduplicate, merge and take the top-k of results from several retrievers at scale, which data structures would you use and at what complexity?
Given tasks with dependencies (such as agent subtasks), implement a topological sort with cycle detection. How should a cycle be reported to the user?

nodes.read_zh: 调试、性能分析、Git和测试工具主题。
nodes.read_en: Debugging, profiling, Git and testing tools.
topics_zh: unit/integration/contract/end-to-end测试的层次
fixture、依赖替身、可复现seed与故障注入
断点、堆栈、日志、CPU/内存profile
静态检查、格式、类型检查与CI质量控制
AI辅助代码审查、测试有效性和依赖升级回归
topics_en: Unit/integration/contract/end-to-end tests
Fixtures, dependency fakes, seeds and fault injection
Breakpoints, stacks, logs and CPU/memory profiles
Formatting, typing, static checks and CI
AI-assisted review, test validity and upgrade regression
nodes.build_zh: 定位一项并发或内存故障，提交可复现案例和修复说明。
nodes.build_en: Diagnose a concurrency/memory fault and submit reproduction plus repair rationale.
checks_zh: 单元、集成、契约和端到端测试各自验证什么？对一个调用LLM的函数，哪些部分该用替身，哪些必须真实调用？
某个测试偶发失败，你如何判断原因是随机性、并发、外部依赖还是时间相关？
AI助手写的测试全部通过，你如何确认这些测试真的有效（例如变异测试，或故意改坏实现看测试是否失败）？
checks_en: What does each of unit, integration, contract and end-to-end tests verify? For a function that calls an LLM, which parts get test doubles and which need real calls?
A test fails intermittently. How do you determine whether the cause is randomness, concurrency, an external dependency or timing?
An AI assistant wrote tests that all pass. How do you check they actually test something, for example with mutation testing or by deliberately breaking the implementation?

nodes.read_zh: Shell、Git、环境管理、远程开发与自动化。
nodes.read_en: Shell, Git, environments, remote development and automation.
topics_zh: venv/uv、依赖锁定、pyproject与包结构
Linux文件、权限、进程、信号和网络诊断
Git分支、diff、rebase、冲突与code review
命令行、脚本、Make/task runner与环境复现
README、API文档、ADR与小步交付
topics_en: Environments, lockfiles, pyproject and package layout
Files, permissions, processes, signals and network diagnosis
Branches, diffs, rebasing, conflicts and review
CLI scripts, task runners and reproducible environments
README, API docs, ADRs and small deliveries
nodes.build_zh: 让陌生人在干净环境按文档运行一个服务。
nodes.build_en: Enable a new contributor to run a service from a clean environment.
checks_zh: lockfile、pyproject和虚拟环境分别解决什么问题？为什么“在我机器上能跑”的代码会在CI里失败？
服务启动了但端口访问不通，你会依次用哪些命令检查进程、端口、权限和网络？
你的分支与main冲突，且多人改过同一文件。比较rebase和merge在这里的取舍，并说明如何让这次变更便于review。
checks_en: What problems do lockfiles, pyproject and virtual environments each solve? Why does code that “works on my machine” fail in CI?
A service starts but its port is unreachable. Which commands would you use, in order, to check the process, port, permissions and network?
Your branch conflicts with main and several people edited the same file. Compare rebase and merge here, and explain how you keep the change easy to review.

nodes.zh: AI辅助编程与Coding Agent工作流
nodes.read_zh: 全文：探索—计划—编码—提交流程、上下文文件、权限与验证；仓库级约定格式对照AGENTS.md。
nodes.read_en: Full guide: explore–plan–code–commit workflow, context files, permissions and verification; compare repository conventions with AGENTS.md.
topics_zh: Claude Code、Codex、Cursor等工具的能力边界、权限模式与费用
先探索/计划再编码：任务拆分、验收标准与小步提交
AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md、Skills与MCP配置：把仓库约定变成可复用上下文
验证生成代码：测试先行、diff审阅、依赖与安全检查、虚构API
沙箱、密钥与生产权限；不可逆操作的人工确认
效率度量与可用AI的面试：讲清自己的判断而非复述助手输出
topics_en: Capability limits, permission modes and cost of tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
Explore and plan before coding: task decomposition, acceptance criteria and small commits
AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, skills and MCP configuration: turning repository conventions into reusable context
Verifying generated code: tests first, diff review, dependency/security checks and hallucinated APIs
Sandboxes, secrets and production access; human confirmation for irreversible actions
Measuring productivity and AI-allowed interviews: explaining your own judgment rather than the assistant’s output
nodes.build_zh: 用Coding Agent完成一个带测试的小功能，保留计划、diff审阅记录与自己修正的错误。
nodes.build_en: Ship a small tested feature with a coding agent and keep the plan, diff-review notes and the errors you corrected yourself.
checks_zh: 把一个功能交给Coding Agent之前，你会准备哪些上下文（AGENTS.md、验收标准、测试）？为什么“先探索和规划再写代码”能提高成功率？
Agent生成的代码调用了一个不存在的库函数，而且顺手改了测试。你在review时如何发现这类问题？
在允许使用AI的面试中，面试官问“这段代码为什么这样写”，你如何展示自己的判断，而不是复述助手的输出？
checks_en: Before handing a feature to a coding agent, what context do you prepare (AGENTS.md, acceptance criteria, tests)? Why does exploring and planning before coding raise the success rate?
Agent-generated code calls a library function that doesn’t exist, and the agent also edited the tests. How would you catch this in review?
In an AI-allowed interview, the interviewer asks why the code is written this way. How do you show your own judgment rather than repeating the assistant’s output?

zh: 传统后端、数据与分布式基础
outcome_zh: 把模型功能接入有身份、数据与运行边界的业务服务。
outcome_en: Integrate model features into business services with identity, data and operational boundaries.

nodes.read_zh: 请求、依赖、异常、认证、测试与StreamingResponse。
nodes.read_en: Requests, dependencies, errors, authentication, testing and streaming responses.
topics_zh: HTTP语义、状态码、REST、分页、OpenAPI和API版本
DNS/TCP/TLS、代理、连接复用与连接超时
SSE/WebSocket、流中断、心跳和客户端重连
request ID、幂等键、错误分类与deadline
上传/下载、对象存储引用和大文件限制
topics_en: HTTP semantics, REST, pagination, OpenAPI and versions
DNS/TCP/TLS, proxies, reuse and connection deadlines
SSE/WebSocket, interruptions, heartbeat and reconnect
Request IDs, idempotency, errors and deadlines
Uploads/downloads, object references and large-file limits
nodes.build_zh: 实现异步任务API与SSE事件回放。
nodes.build_en: Build an async task API with SSE replay.
checks_zh: 比较SSE和WebSocket用于LLM流式输出时的适用场景，以及它们在代理、超时和断线重连上的差异。
用户反馈流式回答经常在30秒左右中断，你会检查哪些环节（反向代理缓冲、超时、心跳、负载均衡）？
设计一个“上传文档并异步解析”的API：请求、状态查询、幂等键、错误码和大文件限制分别怎么定？
checks_en: Compare SSE and WebSocket for streaming LLM output, including how each behaves with proxies, timeouts and reconnection.
Users report streamed answers often cut off around 30 seconds. Which layers would you check: reverse-proxy buffering, timeouts, heartbeats, load balancers?
Design an “upload a document and parse it asynchronously” API: request, status polling, idempotency key, error codes and large-file limits.

nodes.read_zh: 表、JOIN、聚合、事务；配合EXPLAIN。
nodes.read_en: Tables, joins, aggregates, transactions and EXPLAIN.
topics_zh: 实体关系、主外键、唯一约束、规范化与JSON字段
JOIN、窗口函数、聚合、分页和批量写入
B-tree/复合索引、查询计划与慢查询
连接池、迁移、备份恢复与schema演进
关系库/对象存储/搜索索引的职责
topics_en: Entities, keys, constraints, normalization and JSON fields
Joins, windows, aggregates, pagination and bulk writes
Indexes, query plans and slow queries
Pools, migrations, backups and schema evolution
Roles of relational storage, objects and search indexes
nodes.build_zh: 为文档、用户、任务和评测结果建模并优化一条慢查询。
nodes.build_en: Model documents/users/tasks/results and optimize a slow query.
checks_zh: 为“用户—会话—消息—反馈”设计表结构，说明主键、外键、索引，以及哪些字段适合放JSON列。
按时间分页查询会话列表的接口越来越慢，你如何从执行计划判断问题，并改用哪种分页方式？
写一条SQL：统计每个租户最近7天每天的请求数和失败率，并用窗口函数取出每个租户失败率最高的3天。
checks_en: Design tables for users, conversations, messages and feedback. Explain primary keys, foreign keys, indexes and which fields belong in a JSON column.
A time-paginated conversation list endpoint keeps getting slower. How do you diagnose it from the query plan, and which pagination method would you switch to?
Write SQL that counts daily requests and failure rate per tenant over the last 7 days and uses a window function to return each tenant’s three worst days.

nodes.read_zh: 全文；配合PostgreSQL并发控制与版本检查。
nodes.read_en: Full article with PostgreSQL concurrency control and version checks.
topics_zh: 隔离级别、丢失更新、乐观锁与悲观锁
唯一约束、CAS、请求payload与幂等键绑定
at-least-once、重复消息、顺序与去重
transactional outbox、补偿和外部提交结果未知
事件时间、处理时间、版本与审计
topics_en: Isolation, lost updates and optimistic/pessimistic locking
Constraints, CAS and payload-bound idempotency
At-least-once delivery, ordering and deduplication
Outboxes, compensation and ambiguous external commits
Event/processing time, revisions and audit
nodes.build_zh: 复现外部操作成功但本地状态未提交的崩溃窗口。
nodes.build_en: Reproduce a crash between external effect and local commit.
checks_zh: 解释丢失更新问题，以及乐观锁、悲观锁和数据库约束各自如何防止它。
Agent调用“创建退款”工具后超时，不知道外部系统是否已执行，你如何设计幂等键和对账，避免重复退款？
说明outbox模式如何保证“写数据库”和“发消息”一致，并写出至少一次投递下消费者的去重逻辑。
checks_en: Explain the lost-update problem and how optimistic locking, pessimistic locking and database constraints each prevent it.
An agent’s “create refund” tool call times out and you don’t know whether the external system executed it. How do you design idempotency keys and reconciliation to avoid a double refund?
Explain how the outbox pattern keeps a database write and a published message consistent, and write consumer-side deduplication under at-least-once delivery.

nodes.read_zh: Cache、Asynchronism、Back pressure与可用性/一致性章节；重试与幂等对照AWS Builders Library。
nodes.read_en: Cache, asynchronism, back-pressure and availability/consistency sections; compare retries and idempotency with the AWS Builders Library.
topics_zh: Redis缓存模式、TTL、失效、击穿与一致性
消息队列、ack、重试、DLQ和延迟任务
worker池、lease、心跳与fencing token
限流、熔断、隔离、背压与公平调度
任务状态机、进度、取消与可重放事件
topics_en: Cache patterns, TTL, invalidation and stampedes
Acknowledgment, retries, dead letters and delayed tasks
Worker pools, leases, heartbeat and fencing
Rate limits, circuit breakers, backpressure and fairness
Task state, progress, cancellation and replayable events

checks_en: Which LLM-application concepts do Spring AI’s ChatClient, advisors and tool calling correspond to? How does it compare with LangChain4j?

nodes.read_en: Prompt caching guide and the Batch API; compare model catalogs, quotas and data terms in the Bedrock or Model Studio docs.
topics_zh: provider端prompt caching：前缀稳定、缓存命中、TTL与计费
Batch API与异步任务：折扣、完成时限、失败重试与结果对账
速率限制档位、配额、并发与多key/多区域容量规划
reasoning/thinking参数、推理token计费与输出长度控制
OpenAI兼容接口与模型网关（LiteLLM、OpenRouter）：统一鉴权、路由、审计与降级
云平台（Bedrock、Vertex AI、Azure AI Foundry、阿里云百炼、火山方舟）：数据驻留、VPC、合规与模型目录
国产模型（Qwen、DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi等）与海外模型的能力、价格、许可和可获得性
topics_en: Provider-side prompt caching: stable prefixes, hit rates, TTL and billing
Batch APIs and asynchronous jobs: discounts, completion windows, retries and result reconciliation
Rate-limit tiers, quotas, concurrency and multi-key/multi-region capacity
Reasoning/thinking parameters, reasoning-token billing and output-length control
OpenAI-compatible APIs and model gateways (LiteLLM, OpenRouter): unified auth, routing, auditing and fallback
Cloud platforms (Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, Volcano Engine Ark): data residency, VPC, compliance and model catalogs
Chinese models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi and others) versus overseas models: capability, price, license and availability
nodes.build_zh: 为同一业务负载设计调用方案：开启prompt caching并测命中率，夜间任务改用Batch API，记录成本与延迟变化，并写出主备provider切换条件。
nodes.build_en: Design calls for one workload: enable prompt caching and measure hit rates, move overnight jobs to a Batch API, record cost/latency changes and document primary/backup provider switching rules.
checks_zh: 解释provider侧prompt caching的生效条件（稳定前缀、TTL）和计费方式；如何调整Prompt结构提高命中率？
每晚要为10万篇文档生成摘要，比较实时API与Batch API在成本、完成时间和失败重试上的差异。
为公司设计一个模型网关：统一鉴权、路由、配额、审计和多provider回退。国内业务调用海外模型时还要考虑什么？
checks_en: Explain when provider-side prompt caching applies (stable prefixes, TTL) and how it is billed. How would you restructure a prompt to raise the hit rate?
You need to summarize 100,000 documents every night. Compare the real-time API with the Batch API on cost, completion time and retrying failures.
Design a company model gateway: unified auth, routing, quotas, auditing and multi-provider fallback. What else applies when a China-based business calls overseas models?

outcome_zh: 构建可评测、可更新、有权限边界的企业知识应用。
outcome_en: Build a measurable, maintainable and authorized knowledge application.

nodes.read_zh: 支持格式、PDF版面/表格/OCR管线与chunking；对照MinerU的中文文档解析效果。
nodes.read_en: Supported formats, the PDF layout/table/OCR pipeline and chunking; compare Chinese-document parsing with MinerU.
topics_zh: 数据源连接、增量同步、来源许可与数据卡
PDF/HTML/Office/OCR、布局、表格和编码
清洗、去重、内容hash、文档/段落ID与版本
按标题/语义/结构切分、overlap与metadata
批处理、失败重跑、幂等索引和删除传播
解析工具选型（Docling、MinerU、PaddleOCR、Unstructured）与按文档类型的解析质量评测
topics_en: Connectors, incremental sync, provenance and data cards
PDF/HTML/Office/OCR, layout, tables and encoding
Cleaning, hashes, document/chunk IDs and revisions
Structural/semantic chunks, overlap and metadata
Batching, replay, idempotent indexes and deletion
Choosing parsers (Docling, MinerU, PaddleOCR, Unstructured) and evaluating parse quality by document type
nodes.build_zh: 为一个有修订和删除的数据源建立可重放入库流水线。
nodes.build_en: Build replayable ingestion for a source with revisions/deletion.
checks_zh: 比较固定长度切块、按文档结构切块和语义切块；overlap和元数据分别起什么作用？
用户反馈回答引用了一份已删除的旧版文档，你如何设计文档ID、版本和增量同步，确保删除真正生效？
面对扫描PDF、带复杂表格的财报和网页三类文档，你会如何选择解析工具并评估解析质量？
checks_en: Compare fixed-length, structure-based and semantic chunking. What do overlap and metadata contribute?
Users report that answers cite an old document that was deleted. How do you design document IDs, revisions and incremental sync so deletions actually take effect?
For scanned PDFs, financial reports with complex tables and web pages, how would you choose parsers and evaluate parse quality?

nodes.read_zh: 语义检索、embedding模型选择与检索评测示例。
nodes.read_en: Semantic search, model selection and retrieval evaluation.
topics_zh: bi-encoder、query/document表示与训练目标
cosine/dot/L2、归一化、维度和分布
多语言、领域适配、query前缀和max length
embedding batch、缓存、版本迁移与重建
正负样本、hard negatives和相似/相关的差异
按MTEB/C-MTEB与自有数据选embedding模型（BGE、Qwen3-Embedding等）；Matryoshka维度与量化
用hard negatives微调embedding/reranker及其评测
topics_en: Bi-encoders, query/document representations and objectives
Cosine/dot/L2, normalization, dimension and distribution
Languages, domains, prefixes and maximum length
Batching, caches, migration and rebuilding
Positives, hard negatives, similarity versus relevance
Choosing embedding models (BGE, Qwen3-Embedding and others) with MTEB/C-MTEB and your own data; Matryoshka dimensions and quantization
Fine-tuning embedding/reranker models with hard negatives and evaluating them
nodes.build_zh: 在相同qrels下比较两个embedding模型和词法基线。
nodes.build_en: Compare two embeddings and a lexical baseline with the same qrels.
checks_zh: 解释双塔（bi-encoder）embedding的训练目标，以及为什么“语义相似”不等于“与问题相关”。
换用新的embedding模型后，部分领域的检索效果变差了。你如何评估、迁移并重建索引而不影响线上？
如何选择embedding模型：MTEB/C-MTEB分数、自有数据评测、维度和成本？什么时候值得用难负例微调？
checks_en: Explain the training objective of bi-encoder embeddings, and why semantic similarity is not the same as relevance to a question.
After switching embedding models, retrieval got worse in some domains. How do you evaluate, migrate and rebuild the index without disrupting production?
How do you choose an embedding model: MTEB/C-MTEB scores, evaluation on your own data, dimensions and cost? When is fine-tuning with hard negatives worth it?

nodes.read_zh: 倒排索引、BM25与检索评估；ANN看pgvector/Qdrant官方说明。
nodes.read_en: Inverted indexes, BM25 and evaluation; ANN from pgvector/Qdrant docs.
topics_zh: 倒排索引、TF-IDF、BM25和字段检索
精确向量搜索、HNSW、IVF、PQ的直觉
recall/latency/memory、建索引和更新成本
metadata过滤、tenant ACL、分区和权限一致性
Postgres+pgvector、搜索引擎、独立向量库的选型
Milvus、Elasticsearch/OpenSearch与pgvector在规模、混合检索和运维上的对比
topics_en: Inverted indexes, TF-IDF, BM25 and fields
Exact search, HNSW, IVF and PQ intuition
Recall/latency/memory, build and update costs
Metadata, tenancy, partitions and authorization
Postgres+pgvector, search engines and dedicated vector stores
Milvus, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and pgvector compared on scale, hybrid search and operations
nodes.build_zh: 测量索引参数变化带来的Recall@k/延迟取舍。
nodes.build_en: Measure Recall@k/latency tradeoffs across index parameters.
checks_zh: 解释BM25的打分直觉，以及它在哪些查询上比向量检索更好（如产品型号、专有名词）。
解释HNSW的基本原理和关键参数（M、ef）；召回率下降或内存过大时你如何调整？
1000万文档、多租户、需要混合检索，比较pgvector、Milvus和Elasticsearch的选型取舍。
checks_en: Explain the intuition behind BM25 scoring and the queries where it beats vector search (product codes, proper nouns).
Explain how HNSW works and its key parameters (M, ef). How would you tune it when recall drops or memory grows too large?
For 10 million documents, multiple tenants and hybrid search, compare pgvector, Milvus and Elasticsearch.

nodes.read_zh: Retrieve & Rerank完整示例；配合Qdrant hybrid queries。
nodes.read_en: Retrieve & Rerank example with hybrid-query documentation.
topics_zh: 稀疏/稠密融合、score normalization和RRF
候选预算、去重、多路召回与排序
cross-encoder、late interaction/ColBERT
业务过滤、时间、来源与多样性
逐阶段召回损失、重排增益和额外费用
reranker模型选择（bge-reranker、Cohere、Jina等）、截断长度与延迟预算
topics_en: Sparse/dense fusion, normalization and RRF
Candidate budgets, deduplication and ranking
Cross-encoders and late interaction/ColBERT
Business, temporal, source and diversity constraints
Stage losses, reranking gains and cost
Choosing rerankers (bge-reranker, Cohere, Jina and others), truncation length and latency budgets
nodes.build_zh: 比较BM25/dense/hybrid/rerank，并定位一项排序失败。
nodes.build_en: Compare retrieval stages and diagnose a ranking failure.
checks_zh: 解释RRF如何融合BM25和向量检索结果，为什么不直接把两者的分数相加？
加了reranker后答案质量没有提升，你如何判断问题出在召回阶段（正确文档根本没被召回）还是重排阶段？
比较bi-encoder、cross-encoder和ColBERT式late interaction在效果、延迟和存储上的取舍，并设定候选数预算。
checks_en: Explain how RRF fuses BM25 and vector results, and why you shouldn’t simply add their scores.
Adding a reranker didn’t improve answer quality. How do you tell whether the problem is in recall (the right document was never retrieved) or in reranking?
Compare bi-encoders, cross-encoders and ColBERT-style late interaction on quality, latency and storage, and set a candidate budget.

nodes.read_zh: Query translation、routing、indexing与retrieval部分（multi-query、HyDE、分解、RAPTOR、CRAG等）；每项都与基础检索对照。
nodes.read_en: Query translation, routing, indexing and retrieval parts (multi-query, HyDE, decomposition, RAPTOR, CRAG and more); compare each with baseline retrieval.
topics_zh: query rewrite、multi-query、HyDE和查询分解
多轮问题指代、过滤条件提取和检索路由
multi-hop、recursive/hierarchical retrieval和RAPTOR概念
agentic RAG、自检、迭代检索与预算
检索增强带来的收益、循环和无答案处理
contextual retrieval、parent-child/small-to-big切块与上下文补全
topics_en: Rewriting, multi-query, HyDE and decomposition
Conversational references, filters and routing
Multi-hop, recursive/hierarchical retrieval and RAPTOR
Agentic RAG, self-checking and budgets
Gains, loops and unanswerable cases
Contextual retrieval, parent-child/small-to-big chunking and context enrichment
nodes.build_zh: 用一组跨文档问题验证迭代检索的必要性。
nodes.build_en: Evaluate iterative retrieval on cross-document questions.
checks_zh: 解释HyDE、多查询改写和查询分解各自解决什么问题，什么时候反而会降低效果？
一个多跳问题（先查A公司CEO是谁，再查其教育背景）检索失败，你会如何设计检索流程并控制步数和成本？
说明contextual retrieval和父子块（small-to-big）的做法，以及如何用实验证明它们确实带来了收益。
checks_en: Explain what HyDE, multi-query rewriting and query decomposition each solve, and when they hurt.
A multi-hop question (find company A’s CEO, then their education) fails retrieval. How would you design the retrieval flow while bounding steps and cost?
Explain contextual retrieval and parent-child (small-to-big) chunking, and how you would show experimentally that they help.

nodes.read_zh: 引用召回/精确率定义、评测设置与失败分析；声明级标注结合Ragas faithfulness。
nodes.read_en: Citation recall/precision definitions, evaluation setup and failure analysis; pair claim-level labels with Ragas faithfulness.
topics_zh: context assembly、证据顺序、重复和token预算
claim级引用、source span与文档版本
支持/反驳/信息不足；否定、数字、单位和条件
答案正确、证据充分、引用正确的独立指标
拒答、澄清、过期/冲突知识与用户可解释性
topics_en: Context assembly, order, duplicates and budgets
Claim-level citations, source spans and revisions
Support/contradiction/insufficiency and qualifiers
Separate answer, evidence and citation correctness
Abstention, clarification, stale/conflicting knowledge and UX
nodes.build_zh: 标注一组claim/evidence，测量错误支持与覆盖率。
nodes.build_en: Label claims/evidence and measure false support and coverage.
checks_zh: 解释“答案正确”“有依据（faithful）”和“引用正确”是三件不同的事，并各举一个只满足其中一项的例子。
检索到的两份文档互相矛盾（新旧两版政策），模型却只引用了旧的，你如何在上下文组装和提示中处理？
设计拒答机制：什么时候应回答“资料中没有相关信息”？如何衡量拒答率和误拒率？
checks_en: Explain why answer correctness, faithfulness and citation correctness are three different things, with an example that satisfies only one of each.
Two retrieved documents contradict each other (old and new policy), and the model cites only the old one. How do you handle this in context assembly and prompting?
Design an abstention mechanism: when should the answer be “the sources don’t cover this”, and how do you measure abstention and false-abstention rates?

nodes.read_zh: Indexing、global/local search与成本说明；Text-to-SQL部分用本地只读库练习schema linking与校验。
nodes.read_en: Indexing, global/local search and cost notes; for text-to-SQL, practise schema linking and validation on a local read-only database.
topics_zh: 实体/关系、消歧、schema、来源和时间
图遍历、社区摘要与普通关系查询的取舍
Text-to-SQL：schema linking、生成、验证与只读执行
SQL权限、查询预算、注入、方言与结果解释
图/SQL/文档路由、跨源join和评测
topics_en: Entities, relations, schemas, provenance and time
Graph traversal, summaries and relational alternatives
Text-to-SQL schema linking, validation and read-only execution
Permissions, budgets, injection, dialects and explanation
Graph/SQL/document routing, joins and evaluation
nodes.build_zh: 在一个数据分析任务中比较SQL、文档检索与混合方案。
nodes.build_en: Compare SQL, documents and a hybrid analytics workflow.
checks_zh: GraphRAG相比普通向量RAG更适合什么类型的问题？它的构建和更新成本在哪里？
Text-to-SQL生成的查询能执行但结果不对，你如何通过schema linking、校验和只读执行降低风险？
一个助手既要回答“政策条款怎么规定”，又要回答“上月销售额是多少”，设计文档、SQL和图谱之间的路由与结果合并。
checks_en: What kinds of questions suit GraphRAG better than plain vector RAG, and where do its build and update costs lie?
A Text-to-SQL query runs but returns the wrong result. How do schema linking, validation and read-only execution reduce the risk?
An assistant must answer both “what does the policy say” and “what were last month’s sales”. Design routing and result merging across documents, SQL and a graph.

nodes.read_zh: 全文：合成问题基线、检索指标、查询分群与反馈闭环；索引重建、删除与回滚对照pgvector文档。
nodes.read_en: Full article: synthetic-question baselines, retrieval metrics, query segmentation and feedback loops; check index rebuilds, deletion and rollback against pgvector.
topics_zh: 离线qrels、Recall/nDCG/MRR与生成指标
权限canary、版本时间切片与数据泄漏
索引刷新、删除、缓存失效和迁移
失败样本闭环、embedding/reranker升级
质量、p95、资源与每成功问题成本
topics_en: Qrels, Recall/nDCG/MRR and generation metrics
Authorization canaries, temporal slices and leakage
Refresh, deletion, invalidation and migration
Failure feedback and model upgrades
Quality, p95, resources and cost per success
nodes.build_zh: 演练旧文档更新、权限撤销和索引回滚。
nodes.build_en: Drill updates, revoked access and index rollback.
checks_zh: 解释Recall@k、MRR和nDCG的区别；构建qrels时标注粒度（文档还是片段）如何影响这些指标？
RAG上线后答案质量逐渐下降，列出可能原因（文档更新、索引陈旧、问题分布变化）并说明如何监测。
设计一组“权限金丝雀”测试，持续验证不同角色、租户和时间切片都检索不到越权内容。
checks_en: Explain how Recall@k, MRR and nDCG differ, and how labeling granularity (document versus chunk) in qrels affects them.
RAG answer quality degrades gradually after launch. List possible causes (document updates, stale indexes, a shifting question mix) and how you would monitor them.
Design authorization-canary tests that continuously verify that no role, tenant or time slice can retrieve content it isn’t allowed to see.

nodes.zh: 视觉文档检索与长上下文取舍
nodes.en: Visual document retrieval and long-context tradeoffs
nodes.read_zh: 论文方法与ViDoRe评测部分；长上下文取舍结合05.4与05.10。
nodes.read_en: Method and ViDoRe evaluation sections; combine long-context tradeoffs with 05.4 and 05.10.
topics_zh: 页面图像直接检索：ColPali/多向量late interaction与OCR管线对照
表格、图表、扫描件与版面信息的检索与回答
长上下文窗口与RAG：成本、延迟、position bias和context rot
混合策略：检索后整文阅读、长文档prompt caching与分层摘要
多向量索引的存储/延迟成本与评测方法
topics_en: Retrieving page images directly: ColPali/multi-vector late interaction versus OCR pipelines
Retrieval and answering over tables, charts, scans and layout
Long-context windows versus RAG: cost, latency, position bias and context rot
Hybrid strategies: retrieve-then-read-whole-document, cached long documents and hierarchical summaries
Storage/latency costs of multi-vector indexes and how to evaluate them
nodes.build_zh: 在含表格/图表的PDF集合上比较OCR+文本检索、页面图像检索与长上下文直读三种方案的质量、延迟和成本。
nodes.build_en: On PDFs with tables/charts, compare OCR+text retrieval, page-image retrieval and long-context reading for quality, latency and cost.
checks_zh: 解释ColPali直接检索页面图像的原理（多向量late interaction），以及它与OCR流水线相比的优劣。
模型支持百万token上下文后还需要RAG吗？从成本、延迟、位置偏差和权限四个方面论证。
设计一个混合策略：先检索定位文档，再整篇阅读或使用缓存的长文档；如何评估它与纯RAG的差异？
checks_en: Explain how ColPali retrieves page images directly (multi-vector late interaction) and how it compares with an OCR pipeline.
Once a model supports a million-token context, do you still need RAG? Argue from cost, latency, position bias and permissions.
Design a hybrid strategy: retrieve to locate documents, then read them whole or use cached long documents. How would you evaluate it against plain RAG?

outcome_zh: 构建能规划、调用工具、验证结果并从故障中恢复的执行系统。
outcome_en: Build an execution system that plans, uses tools, verifies outcomes and recovers.

nodes.read_zh: 全文与五种可组合工作流模式。
nodes.read_en: Full article and composable workflow patterns.

routing、parallelization、orchestrator-workers和evaluator loop
自主性、可控性、任务复杂度和可验证性
模型/上下文/工具/runtime的数据与控制边界
单次调用、长任务、用户等待和成本
prompt chaining、routing、parallelization、orchestrator-workers、evaluator-optimizer逐一映射任务
topics_en: Fixed flows, dynamic decisions and hybrids
Routing, parallelism, orchestration and evaluator loops
Autonomy, control, complexity and verifiability
Model/context/tool/runtime boundaries
Single calls, long tasks, waiting and cost
Map chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-workers and evaluator-optimizer patterns to tasks
nodes.build_zh: 对同一业务任务设计规则、workflow和agent三版。
nodes.build_en: Design rule, workflow and agent alternatives for one task.
checks_zh: 解释workflow与agent的区别；链式调用、路由、并行、编排者—工作者和评估者—优化者这五种模式各适合什么任务？
团队用全自主Agent实现了一个本可以用固定流程完成的任务，结果不稳定且难以测试，你会如何重构？
针对“处理退货申请”的需求，论证哪些步骤用固定流程、哪些交给模型决策，以及如何控制成本和等待时间。
checks_en: Explain the difference between a workflow and an agent, and which tasks suit each of the five patterns: prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-workers and evaluator-optimizer.
A team built a fully autonomous agent for a task a fixed flow could handle, and it is unstable and hard to test. How would you restructure it?
For a “handle return requests” requirement, argue which steps should be a fixed flow and which left to the model, and how you control cost and waiting time.

nodes.read_zh: Agent基本循环、工具与设计模式单元。
nodes.read_en: Agent loops, tools and design patterns.

目标拆分、计划修订、观察和环境状态
工具选择、参数生成、执行与结果验证
终止、最大步数、循环检测与预算
反思/修复的触发条件与额外开销
topics_en: ReAct, plan-and-execute, ReWOO and CodeAct
Goals, replanning, observations and environment state
Tool choice, arguments, execution and verification
Termination, steps, loop detection and budgets
Reflection/repair triggers and overhead
nodes.build_zh: 实现一个有明确终止条件的只读工具agent。
nodes.build_en: Implement a read-only tool agent with explicit termination.
checks_zh: 比较ReAct、plan-and-execute、ReWOO和CodeAct的控制流程，以及它们在步数、成本和容错上的差异。
Agent陷入反复调用同一工具的循环，你如何检测循环并设计终止条件和预算？
不用框架手写一个最小的ReAct循环：解析工具调用、执行、把观察结果写回上下文，并在完成时停止。

Jailbreak and injection taxonomies, red-team datasets and automated attack tests

Design patterns: plan-then-execute, dual-LLM isolation, CaMeL-style capability control and action allowlists
Evaluating false blocks/misses, latency and cost of guardrails and setting release thresholds
nodes.build_zh: 给P2流程Agent加输入/输出护栏和一种隔离模式，用注入与越狱样例测攻击成功率、误拦率和额外延迟。

Error taxonomies, difficulty, coverage and representativeness

You realize some test questions were seen repeatedly while tuning prompts. What does that mean for your results, and how do you set up a blind test set?
Build a golden test set for a contract-review assistant: data sources, labeling guidelines, handling disagreement, and grouped splits by time or client.

nodes.read_zh: 检索、生成、工具与Agent评分主题。

任务成功、轨迹效率、恢复和循环

Correctness, faithfulness, abstention/coverage and fields
Tool choice/arguments/order/access and environment changes
Completion, trajectory efficiency, recovery and loops
Pass@k, pass^k, repeatability and quality/cost/latency
At-least-one versus all-attempt success; pass@k estimation, pass^k semantics, within/between-task variance and correlated trials
nodes.build_zh: 为同一失败分别给出检索、生成、工具和runtime诊断。
nodes.build_en: Attribute one failure across retrieval, generation, tools and runtime.
checks_zh: 为RAG系统分层设计指标：检索、上下文、生成和端到端各测什么？为什么只看最终答案分数不够？

checks_en: Design layered metrics for a RAG system: what do retrieval, context, generation and end-to-end metrics each measure? Why isn’t the final-answer score enough?
Explain pass@k versus pass^k. What does a high pass@5 but a low pass^5 tell you about an agent?
Design trajectory evaluation for an agent: how do you score tool choice, arguments, call order, permissions and the final environment state?

nodes.read_en: Scorers, model grading, human labels and logs.

judge与生成模型的相关误差
人工校准、一致性、误奖/漏奖和分歧复核
版本、成本、评分器攻击与reward hacking

Pointwise/pairwise and position/length/style biases
Correlated judge/generator errors
Calibration, agreement, false rewards and review
Versions, cost, grader attacks and reward hacking
Challenge the grader with known positives/negatives, alternative valid solutions, parsing edges, exploits and version regression
Align judges with human labels: TPR/TNR on held-out labels, iterate the judge prompt and correct aggregate estimates
nodes.build_zh: 用人工标签校准一个judge并报告其误判样本。
nodes.build_en: Calibrate a judge against human labels and report its mistakes.
checks_zh: LLM-as-Judge有哪些常见偏差（位置、长度、风格、自我偏好）？分别如何缓解？

什么时候用规则检查、参考答案比对、rubric打分或成对比较？各举一个任务说明。
checks_en: What biases are common in LLM-as-judge (position, length, style, self-preference), and how do you mitigate each?
Your LLM judge agrees with human labels only 60% of the time. How do you analyze TPR/TNR, iterate the judge prompt and correct the aggregate estimate?
When do you use rule checks, reference comparison, rubric scoring or pairwise comparison? Illustrate each with a task.

nodes.read_zh: 全文：标准误、聚类、配对差异、方差缩减与功效；bootstrap实现对照SciPy文档。
nodes.read_en: Full paper: standard errors, clustering, paired differences, variance reduction and power; implement bootstrap with SciPy.

配对问题、用户/会话聚类和随机化单位
置信区间、效应大小、多seed和方差
线上A/B、shadow/canary与安全指标
离线—线上相关、选择偏差和多次试验
topics_en: Strong baselines, ablations and fixed budgets
Paired tasks, clustered sessions and randomization units
Intervals, effects, seeds and variation
A/B, shadow/canary and safety metrics
Offline/online alignment, selection bias and repeated trials
nodes.build_zh: 做一项预先声明指标与决策规则的对照实验。

Design a launch experiment for a model upgrade: metrics and rollback conditions at the offline, shadow, canary and full-rollout stages.

nodes.read_zh: GenAI语义约定、trace/span、上下文传播和敏感数据。

Revisions and correlation IDs
Tokens, TTFT, latency, errors and queues
Redaction, sampling, access, retention and export
Langfuse/OTel, alerts, dashboards and root-cause analysis
nodes.build_zh: 从一条隐藏坏轨迹定位慢点与质量退化原因。
nodes.build_en: Diagnose latency and quality regression from an unseen trace.

Contracts, nondeterministic quality and repetition

检索语料被投毒，助手给出了恶意链接。分析攻击路径，并说明guardrail、权限和人工介入各自负责什么。
设计一组场景化安全评测：如何同时衡量攻击成功率、误拦率和可用性？上线时由谁接受剩余风险？
checks_en: Explain the difference between being authorized to access information and it being appropriate to disclose. Give an example of data an agent can read but shouldn’t reveal.
The retrieval corpus is poisoned and the assistant serves a malicious link. Analyze the attack path and the separate roles of guardrails, permissions and human intervention.
Design scenario-based safety evaluations: how do you measure attack success, false blocks and utility together? Who accepts the residual risk at launch?

nodes.read_zh: 已公开GUM论文与事件驱动工程基础；12月2日课程尚未授课，后续对照更新。
nodes.read_en: Published GUM paper and event-driven foundations; revisit after the upcoming2 December class.
topics_zh: 请求触发、事件触发、定时后台任务与持续观察的产品边界
用户声明、行为推断、置信度、来源与可纠正偏好
何时建议、通知、询问或执行；频率、打扰成本和授权
去重、过期事件、竞态、任务取消与资源/费用预算
用户控制、撤回、静默模式、隐私与可解释动作记录
接受率、任务价值、误触发、打扰和长期信任的评测
topics_en: Request/event/scheduled/background triggers versus continuous observation
Declared and inferred preferences, confidence, provenance and correction
When to suggest, notify, ask or act; frequency, interruption costs and authorization
Deduplication, stale events, races, cancellation and compute budgets
User controls, revocation, quiet modes, privacy and explainable action records
Measure acceptance, value, false triggers, interruption and long-term trust
nodes.build_zh: 设计一个可关闭的事件触发助手，用模拟事件评估重复、过期、误触发与权限撤销。
nodes.build_en: Design a disableable event-triggered assistant; evaluate duplicates, stale/false triggers and revocation with simulated events.
checks_zh: 主动式Agent什么时候应该建议、通知、询问或直接执行？如何权衡打扰成本与价值？
主动提醒功能上线后，用户频繁关闭通知，你如何分析误触发、重复事件和时机问题？
设计用户对主动行为的控制方式：偏好声明、撤销、静默模式，以及可解释的动作记录。
checks_en: When should a proactive agent suggest, notify, ask or act on its own? How do you weigh interruption cost against value?
After launching proactive reminders, users keep turning notifications off. How do you analyze false triggers, duplicate events and timing?
Design user controls over proactive behavior: declared preferences, revocation, quiet modes and explainable action records.

nodes.read_zh: 办法全文；标识要求读《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》，北美/欧盟方向读NIST AI RMF与EU AI Act概览。仅作工程理解，不构成法律意见。
nodes.read_en: Full text of the measures; read the labeling measures for marking requirements and the NIST AI RMF and EU AI Act overview for North America/EU. Engineering orientation only, not legal advice.
topics_zh: 中国：《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》适用范围与服务提供者义务
算法备案、生成式AI服务（大模型）备案与安全评估所需的工程材料
《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》：显式/隐式标识与元数据实现
个人信息保护法、数据安全法与数据出境：最小化、同意与跨境调用模型
欧盟AI Act风险分级、GPAI义务与透明度要求；NIST AI RMF与ISO/IEC 42001
模型/数据许可证、供应商数据条款、输出版权与留痕审计
topics_en: China: scope of the Interim Measures for Generative AI Services and provider obligations
Algorithm filing, generative-AI service (model) filing and the engineering evidence for security assessments
Measures for Labeling AI-Generated Content: explicit/implicit labels and metadata implementation
PIPL, the Data Security Law and cross-border transfer: minimization, consent and calling overseas models
EU AI Act risk tiers, GPAI obligations and transparency duties; NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001
Model/data licenses, vendor data terms, output copyright and audit trails
nodes.build_zh: 为一个面向公众的生成式功能列出合规清单：标识实现、日志留存、数据出境与备案材料，并标出需要法务确认的项。
nodes.build_en: Draft a compliance checklist for a public generative feature (labeling, log retention, cross-border data and filing evidence) and mark the items that need legal review.
checks_zh: 概述《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》对面向公众的服务提供者有哪些主要义务，以及算法备案与大模型备案的区别。
按照《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》，你的产品需要在哪些地方加显式和隐式标识？工程上如何落地？
国内业务调用海外模型API会涉及哪些个人信息和数据出境问题？EU AI Act对通用模型和高风险系统有哪些要求？
checks_en: Summarize the main obligations that China’s Interim Measures for Generative AI Services place on public-facing providers, and how algorithm filing differs from model filing.
Under China’s Measures for Labeling AI-Generated Content, where does your product need explicit and implicit labels, and how do you implement them?
What personal-information and cross-border data issues arise when a China-based business calls an overseas model API? What does the EU AI Act require of general-purpose models and high-risk systems?

zh: 项目作品、求职与面试准备

共同要求、专项要求与能力缺口
能力→实现→测试→结果→设计判断的证据链
项目范围、数据与用户可得性
个人贡献、团队协作和可验证结果
topics_en: Country, role family, industry and level
Shared/specialist requirements and gaps
Capability→implementation→test→result→judgment
Project scope, available data and users
Contribution, collaboration and verifiable outcomes
nodes.build_zh: 用真实JD制作能力—作品覆盖矩阵。
nodes.build_en: Create a real-JD capability/portfolio coverage matrix.

你的作品集项目与目标岗位JD匹配度不高，如何调整项目范围或补充证据，而不是从头再做？
为目标岗位写一张“能力→实现→测试→结果→判断”表，至少覆盖3项核心能力。
checks_en: Split a target JD into shared and specialist requirements. How do you tell whether a gap needs learning or just evidence?
Your portfolio project matches the target JD poorly. How do you adjust its scope or add evidence instead of starting over?
Write a capability → implementation → test → result → judgment table for your target role, covering at least three core capabilities.

proposal→基线→中期demo/review→最终评测与复现的里程碑

Clean installation, locks and evaluation commands
Baselines, ablations, per-case results and failures
CI, issues, releases, licenses and contributing
Measurement scope, cost, limits and next steps
Milestones: proposal, baseline, midpoint demo/review, final evaluation and reproduction
nodes.build_zh: 让独立评审人复现作品并提出一个新需求。
nodes.build_en: Have an independent reviewer reproduce the project and request a change.
checks_zh: 一份能让面试官5分钟内信服的项目README应包含哪些部分？为什么要写失败案例和局限？
面试官clone了你的仓库却跑不起来，列出常见原因（依赖未锁定、密钥、数据缺失）及预防办法。
为你的项目设计可复现的评测命令和结果报告：基线、消融、逐例结果和成本。
checks_en: What should a project README contain to convince an interviewer within five minutes? Why include failure cases and limits?
An interviewer clones your repository and it won’t run. List common causes (unpinned dependencies, secrets, missing data) and how to prevent them.
Design reproducible evaluation commands and a results report for your project: baseline, ablations, per-case results and cost.

nodes.read_zh: 岗位与面试流程章节及CS/ML工作流题库；RAG与Agent取舍题用06–07单元自测，编程题按01.4题型限时练习。
nodes.read_en: Role and interview-process chapters plus CS/ML-workflow questions; self-test RAG and agent tradeoffs with units 06–07 and practise coding by 01.4 problem types.

LeetCode高频题型（哈希、双指针、堆、图/拓扑、DP）与限时解题
RAG/Agent/Multi-Agent/MCP的设计取舍
数据与指标、实验、成本、延迟和规模估算
故障定位、权限、回滚和线上反馈
topics_en: Python/SQL/API/concurrency/database questions
High-frequency coding patterns (hashing, two pointers, heaps, graphs/topological order, DP) under time limits
RAG/agents/collaboration/MCP tradeoffs
Data/metrics, experiments, cost, latency and scale
Diagnosis, authorization, rollback and feedback
nodes.build_zh: 完成一轮模拟面试：两道限时编程题、一道SQL题和一组RAG/Agent取舍问答，记录卡壳点并补课。
nodes.build_en: Run a mock round of two timed coding problems, one SQL problem and a set of RAG/agent tradeoff questions; record where you stalled and study those gaps.
checks_zh: 限时30分钟实现一个带TTL和容量上限的缓存，或用堆求流式top-k，边写边说明复杂度和边界用例。
面试官问“你的RAG系统召回率低怎么办”，给出一个结构化的诊断思路，而不是罗列技巧。
如何回答“什么时候不该用Agent”？结合成本、延迟、可测试性和风险给出你的判断框架。
checks_en: In 30 minutes, implement a cache with TTL and a size limit, or a streaming top-k with a heap, explaining complexity and edge cases as you go.
The interviewer asks what you would do about low recall in your RAG system. Give a structured diagnosis instead of a list of tricks.
How would you answer “when shouldn’t you use an agent?” Give a decision framework covering cost, latency, testability and risk.

nodes.read_zh: 全文：设计文档结构、备选方案与评审；事故复盘对照Google SRE书的Postmortem章节。
nodes.read_en: Full article: design-doc structure, alternatives and review; compare incident reviews with the postmortem chapter of the Google SRE books.
topics_zh: 问题、约束、方案、取舍、结果和个人贡献
解释失败、负结果、复现和后续假设
需求澄清、估算、PR/code review和文档
跨团队沟通、演示、交接和维护
面对未见需求的修改与现场诊断
解释一篇相关论文/系统的证据、假设和适用边界，用同伴review发现评测或实现缺口
topics_en: Problem, constraints, choices, results and contribution
Failures, negative results, reproduction and hypotheses
Discovery, estimation, reviews and documentation
Communication, demonstrations, handoff and maintenance
Adapting to unfamiliar requirements and diagnosing failures
Explain evidence, assumptions and limits of a relevant paper/system; use peer review to find evaluation or implementation gaps
nodes.build_zh: 完成一次设计答辩、一条隐藏故障和一次小变更。
nodes.build_en: Complete a design defense, unseen failure and small change.
checks_zh: 用3分钟介绍你的项目：问题、约束、关键选择、结果和你个人的贡献。
面试官质疑你的评测结果“可能是在测试集上过拟合”，你如何用证据回应？
入职后接手一个没有文档的AI系统，前两周你会如何摸清现状、估算工作量并与团队对齐？
checks_en: Present your project in three minutes: the problem, constraints, key choices, results and your personal contribution.
The interviewer suggests your evaluation results come from overfitting the test set. How do you respond with evidence?
After joining, you inherit an undocumented AI system. How would you map its current state, estimate the work and align with the team in your first two weeks?

nodes.en: LLM fundamentals interviews and hand-written implementations
nodes.read_zh: 第2–7章与附录E（LoRA）：tokenizer、注意力、GPT、预训练与微调；不看答案独立重写核心组件。
nodes.read_en: Chapters 2–7 and Appendix E (LoRA): tokenization, attention, GPT, pretraining and fine-tuning; rewrite the core components without looking.

训练与对齐题：交叉熵/困惑度、LoRA原理与参数量、SFT/DPO/PPO/GRPO差异
手写：多头因果注意力、LayerNorm/RMSNorm、数值稳定的softmax
手写：top-k/top-p/temperature采样、BPE merge、LoRA线性层
参数量、显存与FLOPs的口算估计
中国“手撕”与北美live coding的形式差异；边写边讲与边界测试
topics_en: Frequent theory questions: attention complexity, KV cache, RoPE, MHA/GQA/MLA, pre-norm and RMSNorm
Training/alignment questions: cross-entropy/perplexity, LoRA mechanics and parameter counts, SFT/DPO/PPO/GRPO differences
Hand-write multi-head causal attention, LayerNorm/RMSNorm and a numerically stable softmax
Hand-write top-k/top-p/temperature sampling, a BPE merge step and a LoRA linear layer
Back-of-envelope estimates of parameters, memory and FLOPs
Format differences between Chinese hand-coding rounds and North American live coding; narrating while coding and testing edge cases
nodes.build_zh: 30分钟内不查资料手写多头因果注意力与top-p采样并通过自写测试；整理20道原理题的口述答案。
nodes.build_en: Within 30 minutes and without references, hand-write multi-head causal attention and top-p sampling that pass your own tests; prepare spoken answers to 20 theory questions.
checks_zh: 手写多头因果自注意力（含mask和缩放），说明时间与空间复杂度，以及KV cache如何改变推理开销。
解释RMSNorm与LayerNorm的区别、pre-norm为什么训练更稳定，以及GQA为什么能减小KV cache。
不查资料估算：7B模型的FP16权重占多少显存？LoRA rank=8作用于所有注意力投影时大约增加多少参数？
checks_en: Hand-write multi-head causal self-attention (with masking and scaling), state its time and space complexity, and explain how the KV cache changes inference cost.
Explain how RMSNorm differs from LayerNorm, why pre-norm trains more stably, and why GQA shrinks the KV cache.
Estimate without references: how much memory do a 7B model’s FP16 weights take? Roughly how many parameters does rank-8 LoRA add when applied to every attention projection?

nodes.read_zh: 全文：按组件逐层加入的平台架构；通用分布式部分对照System Design Primer。

平台组件：上下文增强、护栏、路由/网关、缓存、Agent编排与观测

容量与成本估算：QPS、token量、缓存命中、GPU/API费用
失败模式与追问：幻觉、越权、延迟尖峰、模型升级回归
取舍表达：先给可行方案，再讲替代方案、代价与验证方式
topics_en: Answer framework: clarify requirements and metrics → baseline → architecture → data/retrieval → model → evaluation → launch → iteration
Platform components: context enhancement, guardrails, routers/gateways, caches, agent orchestration and observability
Classic prompts: enterprise knowledge assistant, support-ticket agent, coding agent, document-extraction pipeline and LLM gateway
Capacity and cost estimation: QPS, token volume, cache hits and GPU/API spend
Failure modes and follow-ups: hallucination, privilege escalation, latency spikes and model-upgrade regressions
Communicating tradeoffs: give a workable design first, then alternatives, costs and how to validate
nodes.build_zh: 45分钟内设计一个企业Agent，画出架构与数据流并估算成本，在面试官改变约束后调整方案。
nodes.build_en: In 45 minutes, design an enterprise agent with architecture and data-flow diagrams and a cost estimate, then adapt when the interviewer changes constraints.
checks_zh: 按“澄清需求与指标→基线→架构→数据/检索→模型→评测→上线→迭代”的框架，在45分钟内设计一个企业知识助手。
估算一个日活10万、每人每天对话10次的助手的token用量和月度API成本，并说明缓存如何改变结果。
面试官追问“上线后发现模型越权访问数据”或“升级模型后质量回退”，你的设计如何应对？
checks_en: Using the framework “clarify requirements and metrics → baseline → architecture → data/retrieval → model → evaluation → launch → iteration”, design an enterprise knowledge assistant in 45 minutes.
Estimate the token volume and monthly API cost for an assistant with 100,000 daily users who each hold 10 conversations a day, and explain how caching changes the result.
The interviewer follows up with “after launch, the model accessed data it shouldn’t have” or “quality regressed after a model upgrade”. How does your design handle each?

North American process: recruiter screens, online assessments, phone screens, onsite loops and referrals
One-page résumé: write project bullets as problem–method–measured result and align them with target JD keywords
GitHub, portfolio and technical writing: let an interviewer find evidence within five minutes

Application tracking, retrospectives, offer comparison and negotiation basics

Prepare a STAR story about a failure or a disagreement with a colleague: what you did and what you learned.
